 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 06.04.2026 CRL.M.A. 10170/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 402/2022 of PS Fatehpur Beri for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and all proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP for State accepts notice and submits that State has no serious objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no.2 identified by IO/SI Surekha also accepts notice.
5. For recording of statement of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 05.05.2026.
